stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
A divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ is a commutative ring $A$, ideal $I$, and operations $\gamma_n:I\to I$ ($n\ge1$), with $\gamma_0(x)=1$, $\gamma_1(x)=x$, $\gamma_n(ax)=a^n\gamma_n(x)$, $\gamma_n(x+y)=\sum_{i+j=n}\gamma_i(x)\gamma_j(y)$, $\gamma_m(x)\gamma_n(x)=\binom{m+n}{m}\gamma_{m+n}(x)$, and $\gamma_m(\gamma_n(x))=(mn)!/(m!(n!)^m)\,\gamma_{mn}(x)$. A homomorphism of divided power rings carries distinguished ideals into one another and commutes with all divided power operations.

For a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$, an $A$-algebra $B$ and an ideal $J\subset B$ containing $IB$, the divided power envelope $D_{B,\gamma}(J)=(D,\bar J,\bar\gamma)$ is the universal divided power $(A,I,\gamma)$-algebra equipped with a ring map $B\to D$ carrying $J$ into $\bar J$: maps $D\to(C,K,\delta)$ of divided power $A$-algebras correspond naturally to $A$-algebra maps $B\to C$ carrying $J$ into $K$. The canonical map $D\to B/J$ has kernel $\bar J$. For a divided power ring $(B,I,\gamma)$, $B\langle x_t\rangle$ denotes the divided power polynomial algebra, the free divided power $B$-algebra on elements $x_t$ of the divided power ideal $IB\langle x_t\rangle+B\langle x_t\rangle_+$, with $x_t^{[n]}=\gamma_n(x_t)$.

Fix a prime $p$ and a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ with $A$ a $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$-algebra, together with an $A$-algebra $C$ such that $IC=0$ and $p$ is nilpotent in $C$. An object of $\mathrm{CRIS}(C/A)$ is a divided power $(A,I,\gamma)$-algebra $(B,J_B,\delta)$ with $p$ nilpotent in $B$ and a compatible $A$-algebra map $C\to B/J_B$; morphisms preserve the divided powers and this map from $C$. The full subcategory $\mathrm{Cris}(C/A)$ consists of objects with $C\cong B/J_B$. The completed category $\mathrm{Cris}^{\wedge}(C/A)$ has analogously compatible objects complete for the $p$-adic topology, with divided powers extended to the completion; for sufficiently large $e$, reductions $B/p^eB$ lie in $\mathrm{Cris}(C/A)$.

For a divided power $(A,I,\gamma)$-algebra $D$ with distinguished ideal $\bar J$, write $D^\wedge=\varprojlim_eD/p^eD$ for its $p$-adic completion. For $P\twoheadrightarrow C$ with kernel $J$, put $P_e=P/p^eP$, $J_e=(J+p^eP)/p^eP$, $D_e=D_{P_e,\gamma}(J_e)$ (for all sufficiently large $e$), and let $J^\wedge$ be the completed distinguished ideal. A divided power structure on $\bar J$ extends uniquely to $J^\wedge$ when $p$ is nilpotent in $D/\bar J$.

Under the affine crystalline setup stated above,
Let $P$ be a polynomial algebra over $A$ and let
$P \to C$ be a surjection of $A$-algebras with kernel $J$.
For $D_e=D_{P_e,\gamma}(J_e)$, where $P_e=P/p^eP$, $J_e=(J+p^eP)/p^eP$ and $e$ is large enough:
for every object $(B, J_B, \delta)$ of $\text{CRIS}(C/A)$ there
exists an $e$ and a morphism $D_e \to B$ of $\text{CRIS}(C/A)$.
